sourceFile: 6. BRS-161016  Report check VP+CD separate when wait dry for along time date 28.3.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The workbook is citeable and comparable, but the draft needs corrected condition coverage and date/test-block grouping before use.
issues: Changed condition list omits rows 30-33 despite using them as outcomes.
Date/test block grouping is not preserved for repeated Normal baselines.
Outcome metric names for blocks 2 and 3 are incorrect row fragments.
Changed factor should be framed as wait-time/process-sequence before dry or press jig, not generic jig comparison.
Header/context rows for result columns are incomplete in outcome evidence.
correctionPlan: Add all tested conditions from rows 16-20, 23-27, and 30-34 under the same changed-factor context.
Set subgroup keys such as test date and result block for each comparison group.
Rename all outcomes to VP/CD vision separate NG count/rate or one unified outcome with block subgroups.
Clarify baseline as Normal within each date/block and changed conditions as process timing/sequence variants.
Cite table headers rows 14, 21, and 28 with the relevant result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but final evidence must include the relevant headers and corrected block grouping.
